summary: Interroute 2-opt* moves whole route tails between two CVRP routes without internal reversal.
description: Input is a feasible route set and capacity data. The generator enumerates tail exchanges and the best-move wrapper evaluates them with the original distance matrix.

Use prefix demands to check the two new loads before materializing a move. Omit empty routes and skip a full swap of both routes or an exchange of two empty tails. A wrapper keeps one strict distance improvement. Each route pair contributes up to the product of its cut counts.
